dataset: the MovieLens-20M dataset (ml-20m), downloaded and preprocessed the way the source repository does
pipeline: the source repository's HSTU-large MovieLens-20M reproduction pipeline (configs/ml-20m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-large-final.gin)
bar_sentence: a MovieLens-20M HR@10 of at least 0.3450 (the source's own 0-1 fraction; published 0.3556)
protocol_sentence: under the source repository's own evaluation protocol (leave-one-out last interaction, ranked against the full 27,278-item catalog with the user's seen items filtered, all 138,493 users; the band's upper bound 1.0 is the metric ceiling, so a x100-scaled field cannot false-PASS)
contract_lines: - The graded run trains the HSTU-large configuration on the MovieLens-20M dataset.

bar_provenance.note: Bar 0.3450 is the HR@10 cell 0.3556 minus a 3 percent tolerance; the ML-1M HSTU-large row (0.3294, README.md:57) is the row the bar has to reject.

phase2_recipe:
Run the source repository's MovieLens-20M HSTU-large recipe, `python3 main.py --gin_config_file=configs/ml-20m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-large-final.gin`, with every setting taken from that gin file and the remaining defaults of `train_fn` in `generative_recommenders/trainer/train.py`. Obtain and preprocess the data the way `preprocess_public_data.py` does for `ml-20m`: download `ml-20m.zip` from the GroupLens URL in `generative_recommenders/data/preprocessor.py`, run the source's `preprocess_rating` to produce `tmp/ml-20m/sasrec_format.csv`, and build the datasets as `generative_recommenders/data/reco_dataset.py` does, with each user's chronological history minus its last interaction as the training sequence (`ignore_last_n=1`) and the full history as the evaluation sequence (`ignore_last_n=0`), truncated to the 200 most recent items. Train the HSTU encoder at the gin settings, which are 16 blocks, 8 heads, dqk and dv of 32, item embedding dimension 256, dropout 0.2, L2-normalised user and item embeddings, the sampled softmax loss with 128 local negatives at temperature 0.05, AdamW with learning rate 1e-3, betas (0.9, 0.98) and weight decay 0, no warmup, local batch size 128, for 101 epochs. After every epoch run the source's full per-epoch evaluation over every user (the per-epoch evaluation logged under `eval_epoch`, not the 128-user batch-stat evaluation that runs every 100 steps): rank each user's held-out last item against the full item catalog from `movies.csv` with the user's already-seen items filtered out, and compute HR@10, NDCG@10, HR@50, NDCG@50 and MRR exactly as `eval_metrics_v2_from_tensors` in `generative_recommenders/data/eval.py` does. The number to write is the full-evaluation HR@10 of the final epoch as a fraction between 0 and 1, together with the highest full-evaluation HR@10 seen at any epoch and the final-epoch NDCG@10.
Write the metrics JSON with at least: {"hr@10": float, "best_hr@10": float, "ndcg@10": float, "epochs": int, "num_eval_users": int, "wall_seconds": float, "device_count": int}
